scope: Thirteen selected candidate clusters, not thirteen verified miracles. No tally adjudication.

cases.source_status: Early Holy Office inquiry, quoted in Castelli; full deposition outstanding
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: Pio gives a named example under oath; Rossi describes evidence from both recipients and Pio.
cases.limits: Pio explicitly uncertain whether bodily presence or a mental representation. No paired timed observations recovered.
cases.next_document: Full Castelli report, Pio deposition and original recipient testimony.

cases.source_status: Early Holy Office inquiry quotation; later Brunatto narrative
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: A second distinct event acknowledged by Pio under oath.
cases.limits: The man is unnamed in the quoted deposition; his later identification and exact date require checking.
cases.next_document: Full Castelli deposition and Brunatto 1926 source.

cases.case: Rizzani birth and Saint Peter’s encounter
cases.source_status: Manuscript facsimile read; Epistolario editorial account traced
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: An actual reproduced handwritten note and a stated chain of custody, rather than an anonymous story.
cases.limits: The displayed note has no year, month, Udine or family name. Exact dating and identification rest on editorial provenance.
cases.next_document: Epistolario IV pp1027–1029 scan; D’Apolito 1978 pp251–272; original custody and civil records.

cases.source_status: Dated diary passage reproduced; original edition outstanding
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: Near-event diary records Agostino’s own conversation with Pio following a sister’s report.
cases.limits: Agostino is not the apparition eyewitness; spiritual visits must not automatically be called physical sightings.
cases.next_document: Agostino Diario pp93–94 and corresponding sister’s statement.

cases.source_status: Sourced published narrative; original statements outstanding
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: Two reported recipients and a specific time accompanying a recovery claim.
cases.limits: No independent signed sibling accounts, patient identity, medical records or exact convent alibi obtained.
cases.next_document: Del Fante earliest source correspondence; parish and medical records.

cases.source_status: Published first-person Viola passage; Positio III/1 p814 lead
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: Named clerical participants and a specific sworn-statement retrieval route.
cases.limits: Clergy attending death were not all apparition witnesses. Original signed statement and conflicting narrative details need checking.
cases.next_document: Viola’s 26 November 1958 statement; Barbieri’s account; Positio III/1 p814.

cases.source_status: Schug 1987 p6 lead; claimed original letter outstanding
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: A prolonged public-appearance claim could be stronger than isolated fleeting sightings.
cases.limits: Congregation size, independent statements, exact date and same-time convent observations not recovered.
cases.next_document: Bonaventura’s original letter to Carmelo and Schug’s source notes.

cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: Named familiar witness, specific dates and a claimed written declaration.
cases.limits: Second encounter is after death, not simultaneous living presence. Do not confuse with his separate wound declaration.
cases.next_document: Voce July–August 1973; Ingoldsby 1978 p90; original Cardone attestations, APP XV/5.

cases.source_status: Italian Positio II pp1638–1639 reproduced in Hegedűs 2013; visually checked
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: An actual canonical testimony extract and a named witness to Pio’s reported affirmative reply.
cases.limits: Battisti relays the prison story from an unnamed priest; not a prison eyewitness. His arrest date is wrong. Mindszenty interview does not explicitly confirm the visit.
cases.next_document: Full dated Positio deposition; named Budapest priest; original Il Tempo 9 October 1971 p13.

cases.case: Msgr John Esseff at Mary Pyle’s house
cases.source_status: Participant interview published 2007; own-voice recording located
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: Accessible named firsthand account and a recording for further comparison.
cases.limits: Other table companions reportedly did not see Pio. No same-minute second-location record. Audio not listened to in this pass.
cases.next_document: Earliest Esseff account, Fr Robert’s statement and Dominic Meyer correspondence.

cases.source_status: Institutional archival study and handwritten denial facsimile
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: Specific contrary primary evidence: the attributed witness repudiated the story.
cases.limits: This addresses that attributed episode, not every bilocation or the wounds. Article footnote’s November date conflicts with visible September draft.
cases.next_document: Original archive Scritti 53-251 and 53-250 if further resolution needed.

cases.source_status: Grandson’s recorded 2020 talk and interview recovered
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: Named family counterclaim with a stated investigation by the general’s son.
cases.limits: Grandson was not a 1917 eyewitness. Character arguments do not prove impossibility. General’s original statement not recovered.
cases.next_document: Carty 1953 p72 and earlier sources; Raffaele Cadorna’s investigation record.

cases.source_status: Later countess/Cardinal Silj narrative; originals outstanding
cases.positive_or_contrary_evidence: A reported alibi check supplies a concrete archival target.
cases.limits: A 1933 Cardinal Siri form is anachronistic: he became cardinal in 1953. A corrected name does not authenticate the other version.
cases.next_document: Countess Virginia Silj-Salviucci / Dellepiane original; audience and convent records.
